description.en:
The statistical dimension. Valid values:
- productCode: aggregates by cloud service.
- region: aggregates by region.
- subUid: aggregates by RAM user.

If this parameter is not specified, data is aggregated by Alibaba Cloud account.
The start time for the data query. Format: 2023-01-01 00:00:00.

description.en: The list of Alibaba Cloud account IDs for which you want to query data. Specify this parameter after you enable the multi-account management feature.
